title: Catering Keywords that Will Get You Clients

facts.fact: The author's rule of thumb is to target keywords relevant to the business that have a keyword difficulty of less than 10.
facts.quote: A rule of thumb would be to target keywords that are relative to your business but have a keyword difficulty of _less than 10_.

facts.fact: The author's rule of thumb is that a keyword with traffic potential greater than 300 is worth trying to rank for.
facts.quote: If the KW has a traffic potential greater than 300, it will be worth trying to rank for the phrase.

facts.fact: The page states that keyword difficulty is rated on a scale from 1 to 100, where a higher number means it is harder to rank in the top 10 for that keyword.
facts.quote: **KW Difficulty** – This is a rating between 1 and 100. The higher the number, the harder it will be to rank in the top 10 for the given keyword.

facts.fact: Using Ahrefs, a third-party SEO platform, the author found the keyword 'catering for 50 people' had an average search volume of 600.
facts.quote: It has an average search volume of 600.

facts.fact: Using Ahrefs, the author found the keyword 'catering for 50 people' had a keyword difficulty of 36.
facts.quote: There is a KW difficulty of 36 assigned to this phrase.

facts.fact: The author estimates that ranking well for 'catering for 50 people' would need more than 47 links, depending on their strength.
facts.quote: this specific phrase would need more than 47 links (depending on their strength) to rank well on results pages.

facts.fact: The page defines search volume as the average number of worldwide searches for a specific phrase.
facts.quote: This indicates the average number of searches worldwide for the specific phrase.
